# Catalog

`c.Catalog` calls the API's Catalog group. The behaviors, the permissions and
the roles that the controller serves, for the UI.

## Methods

| Method             | Returns                      | Permission     | Description      |
| ------------------ | ---------------------------- | -------------- | ---------------- |
| [`Get(ctx)`](#get) | `*Response[CatalogResponse]` | `catalog:read` | Get the catalog. |

### Get

```go
func (s *CatalogService) Get(
	ctx context.Context,
) (*Response[CatalogResponse], error)
```

Get the catalog.

Returns each behavior with its methods, the areas, the permissions, the built-in
roles, the permission of each operation, the tones of the statuses and the
counts, and the host families. The UI reads it after sign-in. Each built-in role
has catalog:read.

It sends `GET /api/catalog`, and needs the permission `catalog:read`.

The examples of the method's definition:

Get the catalog, `go run catalog.go get`:

```go
resp, err := c.Catalog.Get(ctx)
```
